title: Byzantine Alexander Poem (Διήγησις Ἀλεξάνδρου, cod. Marc. gr. 408); «Византийская поэма об Александре»
author: Anonymous
language: Late Byzantine Greek, learned and vernacular mixed
genre: Verse romance in political verse, retelling the Pseudo-Callisthenes Alexander tradition
edition: Reichmann 1963; Aerts 2014 (De Gruyter, Byzantinisches Archiv): text, synopsis and commentary. No open digital text found.
en_evidence: Contents of Aerts 2014 (doi 10.1515/9781614513070): Books I–III text, synopsis, commentary, indices. No translation.
value: A key link between the Pseudo-Callisthenes recensions and the later Phyllada and Rimada. This is directly the editor's specialism, so commentary can tie each episode to the recensions and give a flagship showcase of human-AI expertise.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Late vernacular morphology and Aerts' commentary are aids; the narrative is predictable. Expert oversight is essential.
pilot_unit: Book I opening (Nectanebo and Alexander's birth), about 600–800 verses
